Name: Fabrication: Pressure Regulator for the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation>
MissionBoardDescription: Fabrication contract. The water reclaimer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> on <Alias=TargetPlanetLocation> has blown its pressure regulator, and nobody out there can make another. Build one at an industrial workbench and deliver it by hand. Payment on delivery.

LogEntries.Entry: The water reclaimer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> blew its pressure regulator. Nobody out there can make another, and they've been rationing water since.
The <Alias=TargetLocation> needs a pressure regulator for its water reclaimer. I built one. Now it has to go out to them by hand.
The water reclaimer at the <Alias=TargetLocation> blew its pressure regulator, and nobody out there could make another. I built one and handed it over. They'll have running water by tonight.

Objectives.DisplayText: Build a pressure regulator for the <Alias=TargetLocation> at an industrial workbench
Deliver the pressure regulator to the <Alias=TargetLocation>

Lines.ResponseText: You've got the regulator? Please say you've got the regulator.
The old one was older than me. Nobody out here makes them any more.
Give me an hour and we'll have running water again. Thank you.
What happened to the old one?
Nothing dramatic. It just stopped one morning.
Most things out here do, eventually.
Nobody stocks them out here. The last one came in a crate with the reclaimer, years ago.
Emergency tanks and a lot of not washing.
Everything tastes of the tank. I've stopped noticing, which is worse.
Sorry, there's no water to offer you. Long story.
Mind the tanks. They're empty, but they're heavy.
You're close? Good. Come and find me, I'll be outside.
We've been rationing water for a week. You're the best news we've had.
